title: Prison
text: As I plummeted rapidly, I looked down. I could see a hole with paths branching off in multiple directions, like a slide. On the spot, I thrust my spear into the wall to stop myself from falling any further.
“This… seems to be a trap, doesn’t it?”

How utterly foolish… I began to consider the possibility of slaughtering everyone in this country right now. But if I carelessly cast Skills, my Father and Ren-kun might end up buried alive. What should I do…?

Using a Portal Spear inside the castle is tricky. Even if I could use it from outside the castle to reach the Summoning Chamber… I don’t actually have a portal in the Summoning Chamber to begin with. I’d completely forgotten.

If I use a portal here, I’ll just end up in a nearby village. It’ll take a little while to get back. Before that, though, I haven’t even tested whether it works. It looks like I’ll need to check if it works after I get out of here. Either way…
“I guess we’ll just have to climb up from here.”
I use my spear as a pickaxe and climb back up the slide. It’s dark, so I’ll use Magic to brighten things up. But… it’s like a maze, and it’s hard to tell exactly where I fell from.
Just then, as I thrust my spear into the wall, I heard a faint sound. It seems there’s a hollow space ahead; if so, it might be easier to go through from this side. I raised my spear toward the wall.
“Meteor Thrust!”
With a deafening roar, the spear smashed through the stone wall, sending dust swirling. But now that a path had opened up, I stepped boldly through the breach.
“This place is…”

It’s pitch black. From the looks of it, it’s a dungeon. I suppose even Melromarc Castle has a dungeon or two. …Despite the loud explosion, there’s no sign of guards coming to investigate. It seems I’m quite deep inside.

I sliced through the bars with my spear and made my way out onto the passageway. Hmm… it’s pretty run-down in places… It looks like a small, rat-like monster is scurrying along the edge. When I look to the left, I can faintly hear the sound of running water. Could this be connected to the sewers of Melromarc? If so, I’ll need to go right to head toward the castle.
I start walking to the right. As I walk down the prison corridor, I catch sight of the inmates. Some look well-dressed, while others are just plain shabby.
“Hey. You look like a stranger around here. Are you a soldier from Melromarc?”

The voice made me look toward the cells. I’d been approached by similar-looking people for a while now, but I’d been ignoring them. However, I couldn’t help but focus my attention on this particular voice.

After all, even though it wasn’t a pig’s squeal, it wasn’t a man’s voice—it was a woman’s. Inside the cell, a woman—her hands suspended by handcuffs—was being forced to stand. She was also shackled at the ankles, and the whole scene looked truly pitiful.
“What are you staring at?”
Strawberry-blonde hair and well-defined features. I felt like I’d seen her somewhere before.

Ah! I’m pretty sure she was Big Sister’s friend—the pig who used to train with Ren… or so I recall. My Big Sister’s friend—the female knight who also served as the bodyguard for that detestable Filo-tan’s Finacée… I believe that’s what Father called her.

I see. Since she isn’t a pig, that’s probably why I could hear her voice. If she’s a friend of Filo-tan’s sister, she must surely have a wonderful heart. Calling her a pig would be rude. But why is she being held captive in a place like this?
“I’ve never seen you before… Who are you?”
“That’s exactly what I’d like to ask. What on earth are you doing here?”
“Me? I’m being held for punishing soldiers from my own country who hunted Demi-Humans… I’ve even been stripped of my knighthood.”
“I see…”
“I hope I can stay alive until the Queen returns… though that’s probably just wishful thinking.”

It seems the female knight is being held here until the Queen returns. The Queen… she’s a handy figure I made use of in the previous loop as well. If you threaten someone by mentioning the Queen, things usually go smoothly here in Melromarc.
“So? Who exactly are you?”
I suppose I might as well explain the situation. After all, she’s a friend of my Big Sister’s and the female knight who was guarding Filo-tan’s Finacée. She’s surely not a pig.
“Well, I’m one of the Four Holy Spear Heroes summoned to Melromarc today.”
“What!? Why is the Spear Hero here!?”
At my words, the female knight leaned forward, her chains clanking loudly.
“Tell me the details!”
“As I said, Melromarc summoned the Four Holy Heroes today.”
“Summoned… Then why is the summoned Hero here? How many were summoned!?”
“All four were summoned. The reason I’m here is because I was tricked into a trap and fell into a pit.”
“Setting a trap for the Four Sacred Heroes? Why on earth!? What’s going on in this country!?”

If I knew that, I wouldn’t be in this predicament. But… there are a few possible explanations. Most likely, they thought I was a threat to the people of this country. Actually, since I consider Melromarc an enemy, they aren’t entirely wrong.

“You might not believe me, but I’ve come from the future. And in the future, I revealed that my Father… the Shield Hero—was going to be framed for rape by that pig of a princess, and that she and the king were planning to join forces to condemn him along with the other heroes.”
Huh? The female knight has fallen silent? It seems no one believes a word I say.

“True… that’s entirely possible coming from that princess and the king. They’d likely come up with something in such poor taste—currying favor with the other heroes and laughing as they watch the Shield Hero suffer…”
Her complexion looks even worse than before. Still, it seems she believes me at least a little.

“However, if they did something like that, the nations associated with the Demi-Humans wouldn’t stay silent. My father’s great achievement in trying to build friendly relations would all come to nothing.”
“In the future I came from, Father played a key role in bringing down the Three Heroes Church within the country, and as soon as the queen returned, he was held in high esteem by the nation.”

“A future like that… I’m skeptical, but the exchange we just had isn’t entirely impossible… No, I must have finally lost my mind. To think I’m actually trying to believe this farce… It must be a hallucination.”
It seems the female knight has convinced herself that my words are a hallucination. Perhaps being locked up in a dungeon like this really does drive a person mad.
“When I revealed that truth, I was lured into this trap. I plan to rush to Father’s side as soon as possible.”
Yes, I’m worried about Father’s safety. It would be better if he were leisurely enjoying a meal right now, but that’s unlikely.
“Well then, this is a temporary farewell.”

Considering the future, I’ll probably survive even if I stay like this. Since Big Sister’s best friend is Filo-tan, saving Father might improve my standing with Filo-tan. But right now, if I don’t save Father’s life, I won’t even be able to see Filo-tan.
“Wait!”
“What is it?”

“If… if you’re not just a hallucination of mine, then get me out of here! I have a territory and people I must protect… my father’s words, my code of conduct. It’s true that leaving this cell will only increase my punishment… but I can face that after I’ve confirmed the truth!”
“Understood!”
I don’t know if this will be of any use, but she’s Big Sister’s friend. If she asks for help, I, Motoyasu, will save everyone connected to my Father based on my loyalty.
“Who are you!”
A soldier appeared, pointing his lantern in our direction. It seems we were too loud and have been spotted.
“You’re the spear—”
“Air Strike Javelin!”
I threw the spear, holding back a bit. It’s not that I’ve suddenly become a pacifist—it’s just that unleashing powerful Skills would destroy the path and make things even more troublesome.
“Guh!?”
Ignoring the unconscious soldier, I braced for the returning spear. Then, swinging the spear, I sliced through the bars and severed the chains binding the female knight.
“Come on, now’s your chance.”
“That strength… you really are the legendary hero. Maybe this isn’t… just a hallucination after all.”
After removing her handcuffs, the female knight drew the sword the fallen soldier had been carrying at his waist and followed me.
“This way! I’ll guide you until we get out of here.”
“Understood.”
Guided by the female knight, I sprinted through the dungeon.
“Come to think of it, I forgot to introduce myself. My name is—”
“Was it Éclair?”
I remember Filo-tan calling her that. I’m pretty sure her name was Éclair.
“No! Éclair. Eclair Seaetto! Spear Hero, what is your name?”
“Motoyasu Kitamura. Motoyasu is my given name.”
“Lord Kitamura, is it…? I’ll be accompanying you until it’s clear whether what Lord Kitamura said is true!”
“Understood.”
And so, Éclair and I set out toward the exit of the dungeon.
